LanguageData.CVG_QiConverter_ToggleDesc: Changes the direction of the conversion. Qi to electricity: consumes {1} qi/day from the network and gives {0} W. Electricity to qi: takes {0} W and gives {2} qi/day.
LanguageData.CVG_QT_RequiresConvergence: Requires the Convergence: before it, qi cannot be measured and this project cannot be started.
